messages.author: d5270890ed99d8ca
messages.subject: Issue with wireframes morphologika
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have a question about the wireframes in geomorph. I know it's possible to make your own wireframes in geomorph but I would like to import them instead.

I have a morphologika file with my data which opens perfectly when I don't include the wireframes at the end of the file but I get an error when I have the wireframes in the file and I try to run a gpagen: 
mydata <- read.morphologika("file1.txt") 
Y <- gpagen(mydata, Proj = TRUE, PrinAxes = TRUE)

Error in gpagen(mydata2, Proj = TRUE, PrinAxes = TRUE) : 
  Coordinates must be a 3D array

I understand that my wireframes are not 3 dimensions but 2D. I went through the guide and I thought this was the way to have wireframes in your .txt file but maybe I am missing something (see attached the organization I followed in File1)

Does anyone know how to load wireframes? Should I make a different file?

Thanks in advance!

Ornella

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Issue with wireframes morphologika
parts:
Ornella,

please have a look at the help file of the function read.morphologika. In order to run gpa on your data, you need to use the $coords part of the list that you made. The wireframes should be available in the $wireframe.

Hope this helps

Antigoni

Hi Antigoni,

Thank you for your suggestion, it worked! One weird thing that happened was that the last wireframe from my txt. file would not open in R, so I added 1 1 wireframe at the end of the file to avoid the problem and now it works perfectly.

Ornella
